recognition.summary: The healthcare Hall recognizes qualifying responsible reports; duplicate credit follows first-report rules.

reporting.summary: The policy offers direct encrypted email as an alternative to Zivver secure messaging.

rewards.summary: A thank-you reward may vary with severity and report quality; amount and form are unspecified.

limitations: One coordinator program, not separate entries for each constituent. The direct email link is protected in text extraction; use the policy template. Suspected medical-data access must be assessed by Z-CERT.
